programme.title: Mundial 2026: Francia - España
programme.desc: España tiene el gigantesco reto de alcanzar la segunda final de un Mundial en su historia. La cita de Dallas centrará las miradas de todo el planeta fútbol. Francia es, para la mayoría, el gran favorito del torneo, con individualidades que marcan la diferencia.

programme.title: Buenos días América
programme.desc: Durante el Mundial, este espacio toma el pulso a todo lo acontecido en Norteamérica en la gran cita de Selecciones del año. Las mejores imágenes de los partidos y el análisis para empezar el día informado de lo que ha acontecido durante la madrugada.

programme.title: Copa del Mundo de Fútbol Sudáfrica
programme.desc: España y Holanda se miden en el Soccer City de Johannesburgo por la primera Copa del Mundo de su historia. La selección de Vicente del Bosque mostró su buen fútbol de toque en semifinales, donde dominó por completo a Alemania. El combinado de Bert Van Marwijk, por su parte, ofreció otra muestra de su juego vertical y ofensivo en su victoria ante Uruguay. La España de Xavi e Iniesta contra la Holanda de Sneijder y Robben: dos estilos enfrentados por el título de campeón del mundo.

programme.title: La Dazoneta
programme.desc: El equipo de La Dazoneta se pone en modo Mundial. Un análisis de todo lo que acontezca en la gran cita del verano, la Copa Mundial de la FIFA.

programme.title: Trending Mundial
programme.desc: El Mundial es tendencia. La gran cita de selecciones de la FIFA es, sin duda, el torneo global más seguido del planeta y, por tanto, deja momentos muy comentados.

programme.title: DAZN Mundial
programme.desc: La extensa cobertura de DAZN en el Mundial cuenta con una prolongada previa sobre lo que va a ocurrir durante la jornada. El canal cuenta con periodistas desplazados hasta Norteamérica para acercar al espectador a todo lo que ocurre durante la Copa del Mundo.

programme.title: Mundial 2026: España - Argentina
programme.desc: Cita con la historia en Nueva York. España sueña con levantar la copa más bonita, la del Mundial, y añadir así la segunda estrella al escudo. Una finalísima ante Argentina que por primera vez enfrenta a los actuales campeones de Europa y de Sudamérica.

programme.title: El Post Mundial
programme.desc: Tras los partidos, toca el análisis. Este espacio desmenuza lo ocurrido sobre el terreno de juego en los encuentros del Mundial y aporta imágenes inéditas. Los protagonistas del encuentro también ofrecen su punto de vista.

programme.title: Revelado - Rodri
programme.desc: Rodrigo Hernández se sincera en Revelado, un espacio de DAZN en el que conocemos el lado más personal de los protagonistas.

programme.title: Revelado - Luis de la Fuente
programme.desc: Luis de la Fuente entró sin hacer ruido en el banquillo de la Selección, pero ha conseguido impregnar un sello propio al equipo nacional de España. Con él se han logrado Liga de Naciones y Eurocopa y ahora afronta el reto más complicado: el Mundial.

programme.title: Mundial 2026: Francia - España

programme.title: Football : Coupe du monde
programme.desc: Deuxième du groupe I derrière l'équipe de France, la sélection norvégienne, portée par son attaquant vedette Erling Haaland, poursuit son parcours dans cette coupe du monde, la première du pays depuis... 1998. Mais en face, l'opposition sera de taille. Deuxième du groupe E avec deux victoires et une défaite in extremis face à l'Allemagne (2-1), la Côte d'Ivoire est attendue au tournant, et fait désormais partie des sérieux outsiders qui pourraient créer la surprise lors de cette coupe du monde. L'équipe qui s'imposera ce soir retrouvera en huitième de finale le vainqueur de la confrontation entre le Brésil et le Japon.

programme.title: Football : Coupe du monde
programme.desc: Direction le BMO Field de Toronto pour suivre une rencontre explosive et imprévisible entre le Portugal et la Croatie, deux ambitieux et solides outsiders. Portés par Luka Modric, leur légendaire capitaine, les "Vatreni" vont tenter de prendre le dessus sur une sélection portugaise relativement décevante lors d'un premier tour en dents de scie, marqué notamment pas deux matchs nuls, face à la République démocratique du Congo et face à la Colombie. Cristiano Ronaldo et consorts auront sans nul doute à coeur de montrer un tout autre visage au cours d'une rencontre à élimination directe.

programme.title: Golazo
programme.desc: CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is a first-of-its-kind free, 24-hour channel in the U.S.dedicated exclusively to global soccer coverage. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK, with its unparalleled coverage of all the top domestic and international soccer competitions across the globe, is the ultimate year-round streaming destination for soccer fans. CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK is anchored weekdays from 7:00-9:00 AM, ET, by - MORNING FOOTY, the Network’s flagship morning show. Every weekday, MORNING FOOTY host Susannah Collins along with former U.S. Men’s National Team player Charlie Davies, analyst Nico Cantor and comedian Alexis Guerreros bring their unique voices and fresh perspectives to the latest news and storylines impacting soccer worldwide. As soccer’s new staple show for fans everywhere, MORNING FOOTY delivers a daily dose of razor-sharp insights and laughs with match highlights, compelling analysis, entertaining interviews, updates - from reporter Jenny Chiu and more that is sure to help kick off your day. In addition, the Network will feature live matches, pre- and post-match breakdowns, magazine shows, films from Paramount+’s STORIES FROM THE BEAUTIFUL GAME soccer documentary collection and original programming. The Network’s live matches and re-airs utilize CBS Sports’ collection of top-tier soccer properties, including UEFA club competitions, Serie A, NWSL, Concacaf national team competitions, Barclays Women’s Super League, Campeonato Brasileirão Série A, Scottish Professional Football League, Argentina Liga Profesional de Fútbol and the AFC Champions League, among others. Watch CBS SPORTS GOLAZO NETWORK 24 hours a day, 7 days a week and all 365 days a year.

programme.title: All Elite Wrestling: Dynamite

programme.title: The Vardys
programme.desc: Despite Jamie's best efforts on the pitch, his new Italian side are struggling to get a win and stay out of the relegation zone. On a whistle-stop trip back to the UK, Becky and Jamie stage an elaborate photoshoot but also find a quiet moment to make the big decision - whatever happens with the football, they will bring the kids home.

programme.title: Ainsley's Taste of the Bahamas

programme.title: Deal or No Deal
programme.desc: Stephen Mulhern hosts as David tries to open the 22 red boxes in the right order, taking on the infamous Banker for the chance to win a life-changing cash prize.

programme.title: Tipping Point

Dropping tokens down a choice of four chutes, they hope to knock piles of them off a moving shelf - and the more they collect, the greater the prize fund. The player who has won the least amount is then eliminated, and the last one standing competes for a £10,000 jackpot.

programme.title: The Chase
programme.desc: Bradley Walsh presents as Lauren originally from Canada, Marvin from Stourbridge, Jodie from Nottingham and Adrian from Newark-on-Trent pit their wits against one of the ruthless Chasers in the hope of winning a potential prize pot worth thousands of pounds. They work as a team and play strategically to answer general knowledge questions against the clock and race down the game board to the exit without being caught.

programme.title: ITV Evening News; Weather
programme.desc: A round-up of the day's news headlines and talking points from the UK and around the world.

Marnie's calf starts playing up as he becomes overwhelmed by the noise of the crowd, while Milo enters the young handler contest, and emotions are high for Kelvin and Liz as the show comes to a close.

programme.title: Emmerdale
programme.desc: Kim discovers there has been an intruder, Charity is left utterly defeated and Mack and Vanessa plot.

programme.title: Coronation Street

programme.title: The Dark
programme.desc: DI Kennedy finds a clue to the next intended victim and has to battle to discover his whereabouts before it is too late. But just when it seems she has saved the young man, it becomes clear that the killer is actually playing with her and he has targeted someone else completely. Crime drama, starring Laura Donnelly and Mark Rowley.

programme.title: ITV News at Ten; Weather
programme.desc: A fresh perspective on the major stories of the day, featuring national and international news, with reports and analysis from ITV's correspondents.

programme.title: Peston
programme.desc: Political magazine show hosted by Robert Peston, featuring major interviews with MPs, topical guests and cultural figures. Including updates from social media taking in perspectives from viewers, experts and key players throughout the programme.

programme.title: Love & Death
programme.desc: As their affair continues, Candy fears that she and Allan are at risk of breaking their first rule about having no feelings for each other. programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: CBS News Sunday Morning
programme.desc: The sparkling notes of a trumpet fanfare and the familiar logo of the sun alert viewers that it's time for CBS's Sunday morning staple. Journalist Jane Pauley helms the show, taking over hosting duties from Charles Osgood, who spent 22 years on the job. A morning talk show, this program airs at a different pace and focuses much of its attention on the performing arts. After a quick update of the day's news and national weather, correspondents offer longer-length segments on a variety of topics, from architecture to ballet to music to pop culture to politics.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 6 Fighting Irish face a tough test in the No. 10 Hurricanes. Miami won the last meeting, 41-8 in 2017. Notre Dame came up short against Ohio State 34-23 in the national title game last season. Miami was ranked as high as No. 4 in 2024.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The Razorbacks (2-2) face the No. 22 Fighting Irish (1-2). Arkansas dropped back-to-back road games to Ole Miss and Memphis after a 2-0 start at home. Jadarian Price found the end zone four times Sept. 20 in Notre Dame's 56-30 win over Purdue.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 12 Fighting Irish (5-2) vie for a sixth straight victory as they visit the Eagles (1-7). Notre Dame has won nine straight Holy War meetings. Fighting Irish junior Jeremiyah Love has rushed for 417 yards and four TDs in the last three games.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: Surging 7-2 sides meet in the Steel City as the No. 9 Fighting Irish visit the No. 22 Panthers. Notre Dame boasts a seven-game win streak. Pittsburgh has won five in a row. The Fighting Irish won the last two engagements by a combined 103-10 score.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 9 Fighting Irish end their regular season by visiting the Cardinal. Notre Dame has won nine straight games, against teams with a combined 45-53 record entering Week 14, after scoring its most points since 1932 in a 70-7 win over Syracuse.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The Seminoles put 2024 in the rearview during this opener against the No. 8 Crimson Tide. Florida State went a forgettable 2-10 last year. Alabama turns to Ty Simpson at quarterback after Jalen Milroe was drafted by the NFL's Seattle Seahawks.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 21 Crimson Tide limp home to face the Warhawks. Alabama had its streak of season-opening victories stopped at 23 games with a 31-17 setback at Florida State. Germie Bernard (ALA) registered a career-high 146 receiving yards in that contest.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 19 Crimson Tide (1-1) prepare for another test as they host the Badgers (2-0) in Week 3. Alabama got on the board with a 73-0 dismantling of Louisiana Monroe on Sept. 6. Bama rolled to a 42-10 verdict over Wisconsin on Sept. 14, 2024.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 5 Bulldogs (3-0, 1-0 SEC) take on the No. 17 Crimson Tide (2-1, 0-0). Alabama has won both meetings since Georgia claimed the 2021 title over the Tide. Ryan Williams (ALA) posted 177 receiving yards in last year's 41-34 win.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 16 Commodores (5-0, 1-0 SEC) vie for their first win streak against the No. 10 Crimson Tide (3-1, 1-0) since 1956. Vanderbilt snapped a 23-game series slide with a 40-35 victory in 2024. Alabama won at then-No. 5 Georgia 24-21 in Week 5.

programme.title: Live: Unsportsmanlike with Evan, Canty and Michelle
programme.desc: Start the day off right with Chris Canty, Evan Cohen and Michelle Smallmon providing an energizing and informative way to take on the day. Sports, life and laughter are what it's all about.

programme.title: College Football
programme.desc: The No. 14 Tigers (5-0, 1-0 SEC) brace for the No. 8 Crimson Tide (4-1, 2-0). Alabama has won four in a row after prevailing 30-14 over Vanderbilt on Oct. 4, and is 5-0 versus Missouri since 2012. Mizzou is 5-0 for the second time in three years.

programme.title: College Football

programme.title: Live: Good Morning Football
programme.desc: NFL Network enters the morning show fray with a three-hour live presentation. Each day, "Good Morning Football" brings viewers up-to-the-minute breaking NFL news and local NFL stories on a national platform. The show features a combination of headline-making interviews and a discussion of a wide array of issues in the areas of sports, news and entertainment. By booking celebrity guests and opinionated national and local journalists -- and taking advantage of a close collaboration with all 32 NFL franchises -- "Good Morning Football" breaks out within and well beyond its time period.

programme.title: Live: MLB Central
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever regular-season morning show features hosts Robert Flores, Mark DeRosa and Lauren Shehadi reporting from Studio 21, named in honor of Hall of Famer and humanitarian Roberto Clemente. Updates and context on the latest news, extensive on-field highlights, and long-form conversations with guests, celebrities and insiders from around baseball are presented each weekday morning. Flores joined the network in 2016 as a host/reporter, DeRosa offers a unique outlook as a former player, and Shehadi honed crisp interviewing skills during three years of hosting MLB Network's "The Rundown.".

programme.title: Live: MLB Now
programme.desc: The hourlong weekday afternoon "MLB Now" presents the day's top stories in baseball by spanning the sport's cultural divide. Host Brian Kenny discusses the issues and provides analysis, with a bent toward modern analytics to prove his points. The series also features interviews with personalities throughout the game, and viewer opinions are welcome as well via social media polls.

programme.title: Live: Intentional Talk
programme.desc: MLB Network's first-ever talk show is an open forum that features some talk and a lot of banter each weekday for host Kevin Millar, who discusses with special guests what's hot and what's not in and around the national pastime. He also runs out of the baseline at times by welcoming guests from the worlds of entertainment and pop culture to talk about trending topics in those arenas. Millar gained fame as a member of the 2004 world champion Boston Red Sox, and since he retired from the diamond his knowledge of the game and warm, affable personality have vaulted him into a lengthy career in the media.
